title: 각병과사병의군사경찰직무보조에관한규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:30384:20200204:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act <Presidential Decree No. 30384, February 4, 2020>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2
Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) Part of the Regulations on Assistance by Enlisted Personnel of Various Branches in Military Police Duties (formerly the Regulations on Assistance in Military Provost Duties) shall be amended as follows:
The title "Regulations on Assistance by Enlisted Personnel of Various Branches in Provost Duties" shall be replaced with "Regulations on Assistance by Enlisted Personnel of Various Branches in Military Police Duties".
The heading of Article 1, "(Persons Authorized to Order Assistance in Provost Duties)", shall be replaced with "(Persons Authorized to Order Assistance in Military Police Duties)", and "provost" in the portion of that Article other than its heading shall be replaced with "military police".
In the portion of Article 2 other than its subparagraphs, "provost commander", "provost battalion commander", "provost company commander", and "provost duties" shall be replaced with "military police commander", "military police battalion commander", "military police company commander", and "military police duties", respectively; in paragraph (2) of that Article, "provost duties" shall be replaced with "military police duties".
In Article 3, "auxiliary provost duties" shall be replaced with "auxiliary military police duties".
Article 4 shall be replaced with the following:
Article 4 (Duties of Enlisted Personnel Assisting Military Police)
Enlisted personnel assisting the military police shall temporarily assist in military police duties under the direction of the military police commander, the commander of a military police battalion, or the commander of a subordinate unit thereof.
Article 5 shall be replaced with the following:
Article 5 (Application Mutatis Mutandis of Military Police Decree)
The Military Police Decree shall apply mutatis mutandis to enlisted personnel assisting the military police.
In Article 6, "enlisted personnel assisting the provost" shall be replaced with "enlisted personnel assisting the military police", and each reference to "provost" shall be replaced with "military police".
(2) through (14) Omitted.

Article 3
Omitted.
